violations.why: irq_vessel can preempt irq_upland and call enable_isr(3), which unmasks irq_nimbus globally. Nimbus can then run between upland's two reads and write v_amber.
After irq_vessel unmasks interrupt 3 during irq_upland, irq_nimbus can run between the two reads of v_fjord. It writes 0x09 only if v_delta is still 1.
